## About
Q2 Machines (written Q² Machines; also known as Q2M and Q2 Machining; trading as Quarryquip Ltd) is a Trinidad-based engineering firm, operating since 2013. We design, manufacture and service industrial plant equipment for clients across the Caribbean, Venezuela, Colombia, Guyana and South America.

Our core philosophy: Imagination, Ideas & Innovation.

## Location
71 Warren Road, Bejucal, Cunupia, Trinidad and Tobago

## Contact
- Phone: +1 (868) 230-9702
- Email: qhub@q2m.io
- Website: https://www.q2m.io
- Hours: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (AST, UTC-4)

## Industries Served

## Services
1. Conveyor & Bulk Handling Systems
   Custom engineered belt conveyors, screw/auger conveyors, bucket elevators and bulk handling solutions — from design through to installation and commissioning.

2. Concrete Plants
   Stationary and mobile concrete batching plants, designed, built and commissioned entirely in-house.

3. Motors & Pumps
   Supply, rewind, repair and service of AC/DC motors and all pump types including centrifugal, submersible and gear pumps.

4. Gear Reducers
   Supply, strip-down repair and service of gear reducers and gearboxes across all major brands.

5. Machine Shop
   Precision CNC and conventional machining to exact tolerances, performed entirely in-house.

6. Fabrication & Welding
   Heavy industrial and structural fabrication, pipe welding and coded welds — SMAW, MIG, TIG and FCAW processes, certified and quality assured.

7. Structural Systems
   Design, fabrication and erection of industrial and commercial steel structures, bridges, walkways, platforms, pipe racks and access systems.

8. Geotechnical Testing Equipment
   Supply, calibration and support of geotechnical testing equipment including dynamic cone penetrometers, CBR equipment, compaction hammers and ASTM molds.

## Capabilities
- Full in-house design and engineering
- In-house fabrication and welding workshop
- In-house machine shop (CNC and conventional)
- Project management and site supervision
- Plant upgrades and modernisation
- Turnarounds and scheduled maintenance
- After-sales support and spare parts

## Equipment Depot
New, used and refurbished industrial equipment for sale, available for inspection and export. Stock has included centrifugal pumps, a vibrating rinsing screen, a concrete mixer, jaw and impact crushers and dump trucks. Prices are on request; enquire for pricing and availability.
https://www.q2m.io/depot.html

## Projects
Completed projects include a sand and gravel wet processing plant upgrade (Valencia, Trinidad, 2016) and a ready-mix concrete batching plant (Port of Spain, Trinidad, 2020).
https://www.q2m.io/projects.html

## Frequently Asked Questions
- What does Q2 Machines do? Design, manufacture and service of industrial plant equipment: conveyor and bulk handling systems, concrete batching plants, structural steelwork, and motors, pumps and gear reducers.
- Can you build custom systems? Yes. Design, engineering and manufacturing are done in-house, from concept through commissioning and after-sales support.
- Do you work outside Trinidad? Yes: the Caribbean, Venezuela, Colombia, Guyana and South America.
- Do you sell new and used equipment? Yes, through the Equipment Depot. Prices are on request.
- Do you repair motors, pumps and gear reducers? Yes.
- How do I contact you? +1 (868) 230-9702 or the contact form at https://www.q2m.io/#contact. Open Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM.
